jobs.title: Civil Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Overview:** The Civil Engineer applies their conceptual knowledge of civil and, with a moderate level of guidance and direction from colleagues and leadership, is responsible for solving a range of straightforward civil problems. They will be responsible for analyzing possible solutions using standard procedures and building knowledge of the company, processes, and customers. The Civil Engineer understands key business drivers and applies this knowledge to solve problems in straightforward situations by analyzing possible solutions using technical experience, judgment, and precedents. Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably. For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries. **Key Tasks and Responsibilities:** * Perform FEED, Studies, and detailed design engineering, analysis, and calculations on more complex and demanding engineering tasks * Apply knowledge and skills to complete varied assignments * Prepare clear and accurate detailed design calculations and analyses, including design reports and procedures * Prioritize and organize own work to meet deadlines * Focus on completing work within budgets * Communicate and explain information in straightforward engineering activities * Gain familiarity with the project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and all inter-discipline requirements, including identifying concerns as early as practicable * Initiate interface with other disciplines to obtain input for discipline designs * Perform computer analyses of foundations and structures designed by others with guidance from Senior/Principal Engineers * Prepare design calculations as required * Assist in the preparation of specifications with guidance from colleagues * Perform engineering check of drafting * Perform engineering checks prepared by others within the discipline * Perform design verification through single discipline check and assist with inter-discipline checks (IDC) * Prepare & review MTOs of foundations and structures under the supervision * Provide engineering support as required * Assist in the preparation of subcontract documents * Review vendor data Assist in bid evaluations Reports to: Project: Lead Engineer Functional: Supervising Department Manager Liaise With: All design/drafting disciplines, all Engineering disciplines, Construction site/Fabrication groups, and Document Control Supervises: Trainee Engineers **Essential Qualifications and Education:** * Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Engineering * 3-8 years of experience in oil and gas with a major contractor or consultant, predominantly performing detail design * Preferably Registered Engineer in Training (EIT) or member of a professional engineering society as applicable * Eager to learn * Working knowledge of English, both oral and written * HSE, TQM, and cost-conscious * Show flexibility and ensure proper hand-over with regard to: + The reassignment to other departments, construction sites, and fabrication yards + The replacement of colleagues during illness and holidays. + The provision of assistance to other colleagues with heavy workloads (also other projects) when possible/desirable + The managing/learning of future current working methods and software applications * Accredited engineering degree as may be required by specific regions * Familiar with the use of codes and standards * Familiar with the content and application of standards, codes, and guidelines as applicable. Knowledge of many basic design techniques and analysis methods * Minimum 5-10 years working experience in the heavy construction industry. * Able to use MS office, 2D AutoCAD, able do to Civil/Mechanical/Electrical analysis would be an advantage. Fluent in English both oral and written. #LI-LD1

jobs.title: Frontend Software Engineer - Global Payment - Jakarta
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Location :** Jakarta **Team :** Frontend **Employment Type :** Regular **Job Code :** A137843 Responsibilities About Global Payment Team Our Web and Client team in Global Payment is committed to building a highly integrated payment product that can be easily connected to the Web, App, cross-platform and other forms of Global Payment capabilities. In addition, we provide efficient and comprehensive services to developers, merchants and others through a series of platforms. Responsibilities - Build global consumer digital wallets and payment products to support global ecosystem business and users. As part of the international payment team, participate in system design, research and development, technological innovation, etc; - Build payment products for consumer users and cross platform products based on Web technology, including mobile and PC products; - Collaborate with product design, product management and software engineering teams to drive business success in efficiency and safety; - Keep at the forefront of emerging web-based technologies and trends, research and evaluate the latest web development frameworks, apply new technologies to drive iterative product improvements. Qualifications Minimum Qualification(s) - Experience in developing frontend web applications - Strong in JavaScript/HTML/CSS frontend experience, skilled in common web platforms such as React/Vue/Angular, and have good practice and understanding of common web compilation and bundling frameworks, including Webpack/Rollup/Babel/AST; - Have solid experience in implementing web applications with high performance, high availability, and excellent user experience; - Good problem solving skills and thinking patterns in web-based system design. Preferred Qualification(s) - Minimum 5 years relevant work experience from a large-scale internet business. - Experience in e-wallet and payment product development; - Agile, quick self learner, highly self-motivated with a strong sense of product ownership and creative problem solver; - Good collaborator and team player, comfortable working in a fast pace, diversified and global team environment. Job Information About Us Founded in 2012, ByteDance's mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. With a suite of more than a dozen products, including TikTok, Lemon8, CapCut and Pico as well as platforms specific to the China market, including Toutiao, Douyin, and Xigua, ByteDance has made it easier and more fun for people to connect with, consume, and create content. ​ Why Join ByteDance Inspiring creativity is at the core of ByteDance's mission. Our innovative products are built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and enrich life - a mission we work towards every day. ​ As ByteDancers, we strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our Company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us. ​ Diversity & Inclusion ​ ByteDance is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At ByteDance, our mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Category:** Engineering Product **Job Type:** Full Time **Job Location:** Bandung **Job Status:** Priority Hiring Bandung, Indonesia · Full-Time **About the Role** ------------------ We're looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer who is passionate about building impactful solutions that transform education. This role requires strong skills across both front-end and back-end, with the ability to design, build, and scale applications that are reliable, user-friendly, and aligned with our mission. You'll build end-to-end across our stack, working heavily with AI coding tools (especially Claude Code) — which means you'll direct that work, review it critically, and own the correctness and quality of what ships, front to back. We value adaptability, ownership, and a strong learning attitude. **Our stack:** Next.js + React (TypeScript, Tailwind) on the front end · Node.js/Express and Python/FastAPI on the back end · MongoDB + Redis · Git + CI/CD · GCP. These are deliberate, AI-friendly choices, so you can move fast and still review with confidence. **Before You Apply** -------------------- This role is not light, routine, or heavily guided. You'll handle ambiguity, move quickly across multiple priorities, and deliver production-ready solutions with little to no revision — including code an AI agent drafted and you made correct. You must stay calm under pressure, take full responsibility for your work, and deliver reliable outputs even when requirements shift mid-week or feedback needs a fast turnaround. If you want a role that will stretch your technical range, sharpen your problem-solving, and connect your work to a mission that matters, we'd love to hear from you. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Full-Stack Development** * Design and build front-end and back-end features for web and mobile: responsive, accessible interfaces in Next.js/React, and scalable APIs and services in Node.js/Express and Python/FastAPI. * Own features end-to-end — data model to UI — with sound design decisions and rigorous testing. * Work with MongoDB and Redis for reliable, performant data and state. **AI-Assisted Development & Oversight** * Direct Claude Code and other AI tools to build features fast, writing clear specs and prompts. * Review and refine AI-generated code across the stack; you're accountable for correctness, security, and maintainability — not the AI. * Set conventions and tests that keep AI output consistent and safe to ship. **Collaboration & Delivery** * Partner with product, design, and program teams to turn requirements into effective solutions. * Take part in agile ceremonies and code reviews, keep CI/CD deployments fast and safe, and provide prompt support for live systems. * Maintain clear technical documentation for the systems you build. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 3+ years as a full-stack developer shipping applications in production. * **Front end:** proficiency with Next.js/React and TypeScript (Tailwind or similar). * **Back end:** strong skills in Node.js/Express and/or Python/FastAPI; comfortable with Next.js server-side code. (Depth on one end plus solid range across the rest is fine — you don't need to be an expert in everything.) * Experience with MongoDB and Redis, and sound API design. * Disciplined testing, plus Git and CI/CD. * Ability to direct AI coding tools (especially **Claude Code**) and critically review their output — strong enough to catch what the AI gets wrong. * Strong problem-solving, attention to detail, accountability, and the ability to work independently under pressure. **Bonus Points If You Have** ---------------------------- * Containerized deployments (Docker or similar). * Experience with AI/ML or data-driven applications. * Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD beyond the basics. * A real knack for prompt and workflow design with agentic coding tools. * Experience in edtech, mission-driven, or non-profit projects. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- You'll be joining a team with a bold mission to transform education. We don't expect perfection, but we do expect creativity, ownership, and a strong learning attitude. If you're looking for routine work, this may not be the right fit. But if you're ready to build end-to-end solutions that matter and create real-world impact — we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Front End)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Description** Job Description Our Tech & Product team members hail from the top company working experiences such as Facebook, Google, Amazon, Uber, Twitter, and Traveloka. Responsibilities: * You'll brainstorm with Product Managers, Designers, and Backend Engineers on your team to conceptualize and build new features for GudangAda large (and growing!) user base. * You’ll produce high-quality results by contributing heavily to team projects that have a significant impact on the business. * You’ll actively own team features or systems and define their long-term health, while also improving the health of surrounding systems. * You'll assist our skilled support team and operations team in triaging and resolving production issues. * You'll mentor other engineers and deeply review code. * You’ll improve engineering standards, tooling, and processes Tech stack that we use: * Reactjs * NextJS * Typescript * Redux: Library * TailwindCSS * Material UI: Design System **Qualifications** We are looking for someone with: * Deep passion for software engineering with an excellent understanding of software engineering concepts, design patterns, and algorithms. * You can contribute to technical architecture discussions and help drive technical decisions within your team. * You write understandable, testable code with an eye towards maintainability. * You are a strong communicator. Explaining complex technical concepts to designers, support, and other engineers is no problem for you. * You possess strong computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, programming languages, distributed systems, and information retrieval. * You have **completed** a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field, or equivalent training, fellowship, or work experience. **Additional Information** What will you get on working at GudangAda? * Competitive salary * Learning experience * Personal Growth * Impact at scale * Mentorship from a world-class team

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Spesifikasi Fisik** --------------------- Tinggi Min. 170 cm Berat Min. 50 kg **Deskripsi Pekerjaan** ----------------------- * Merancang dan mengelola arsitektur backend POS termasuk API, database transaksi, dan service layer agar sistem mampu menangani volume transaksi tinggi tanpa gangguan performa. * Mengelola integrasi sistem POS dengan modul pendukung seperti inventory, finance, CRM, loyalty, payment gateway, dan third-party services lainnya. * Menjaga keamanan data transaksi dan sistem POS dengan menerapkan authentication, authorization, logging, dan best practice security sesuai standar sistem pembayaran dan data pelanggan. * Melakukan troubleshooting, debugging, dan perbaikan bug pada sistem backend POS secara cepat untuk mekan downtime operasional outlet. * Mengoptimalkan performa sistem POS melalui tuning database, optimasi query transaksi, dan monitoring sistem backend agar tetap responsif pada jam operasional padat. * Berkolaborasi dengan tim frontend POS, QA, product, dan operation outlet untuk memastikan fitur POS berjalan sesuai kebutuhan operasional lapangan. * Menyusun dan memperbarui dokumentasi teknis backend POS termasuk API documentation, alur transaksi, dan catatan perubahan sistem sebagai referensi pengembangan dan maintenance. **Persyaratan** --------------- * S1 Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Ilmu Komputer, Teknik Komputer atau bidang relevan * Pengalaman minimal 1 - 3 tahun sebagai Backend Developer * Soft Competency: Analytical Thinking, Problem Solving, Communication Skill, Team Work, Time Management * Technical Competency: Backend Development for Transactional System, POS System Architecture, RESTful API Development, Payment Gateway Integration, System Security & Data Protection **Ringkasan lowongan** ---------------------- Kategori FULLTIME Departemen HOLYPOS DEPARTMENT Outlet SENTRAL JELUPANG 2 Kebutuhan 1 Orang · Pria

jobs.title: Full-Stack JavaScript Developer (AI-Native)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About UltaHost** UltaHost is a rapidly growing global web hosting and cloud infrastructure provider delivering high-performance hosting, VPS, dedicated servers, and cloud solutions to customers worldwide. Our mission is to provide reliable, scalable, and innovative infrastructure services while maintaining exceptional customer satisfaction. As our global operations continue to expand, we are looking for talented professionals to join our international team and contribute to our long-term growth. **Job Overview** UltaHost is looking for a highly skilled **Full-Stack JavaScript Developer (AI-Native)** to join our Engineering team. This role is ideal for an experienced software engineer who enjoys building modern web applications across the entire technology stack while leveraging AI-assisted development workflows to deliver high-quality software efficiently. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable backend services and modern frontend applications using JavaScript and TypeScript technologies. Working closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers, you will take ownership of features from specification through production while maintaining high standards for code quality, security, and performance. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using **Node.js, NestJS, React, Next.js, and TypeScript** * Build secure and maintainable REST APIs, authentication systems, and backend services * Design and maintain database schemas using Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL, * MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis where appropriate * Use AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar as part of your daily development workflow * Collaborate closely with Product, Design, QA, and Engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, Docker-based development environments, and deployment processes **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience) * 4+ years of professional Full-Stack JavaScript development experience * Strong expertise in JavaScript and TypeScript * Production experience with Node.js and NestJS * Strong experience with React and Next.js * Hands-on experience with Prisma ORM, PostgresSQL/MySQL, MongoDB/Redis * Experience with Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines * Experience writing unit and integration tests using Jest, Vitest, Supertest, or similar frameworks * Daily experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex CLI, or similar * Strong understanding of software architecture, scalability, security, and modern engineering best practices * Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building AI-powered applications using LLM APIs * Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI agent frameworks, or AI automation * Experience working on SaaS, hosting, cloud, or infrastructure platforms * Experience with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD platforms * Experience optimizing application performance and large-scale systems * Passion for AI-assisted software engineering and continuous improvement **What We Offer** * Opportunity to work in a fast-growing international technology company * Professional and collaborative engineering environment * Remote-first work culture * Career growth and professional development opportunities * Opportunity to work with modern AI-native development workflows * Exposure to large-scale cloud infrastructure and global software products * Dynamic and innovation-driven company culture

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About the role** We build software for a regulated, safety-critical industry, where the decisions our users make have to be accurate, traceable, and defensible. Our clients rely on the product in their day-to-day operations, and the work is a mix of improving what exists and building what clients need next. **What you will do** * Build and maintain features end to end across a React frontend and a Python backend * Design REST APIs and data models on PostgreSQL, with permissions, auditability, and data integrity built in * Work on geospatial and document-generation features * Keep calculation-heavy logic correct through versioned rules and regression tests * Diagnose production issues and strengthen automated tests and CI * Support user testing, go-live, and ongoing client-driven fixes **What you bring** * Strong TypeScript/React and Python for production services * Solid PostgreSQL: schema design, migrations, query performance, and row-level security * REST API design and authorization (JWT, role-based access) * Hands-on Supabase (Auth, RLS, RPC) and Cloudflare (Pages, Workers, R2, Zero Trust) * Docker, GitHub Actions, and Linux server operations * Experience integrating OIDC/SAML single sign-on * Practical geospatial data handling (PostGIS, GeoJSON, or equivalent) * A testing habit, strong Git and code-review practice, and comfort shipping to production * English and Bahasa Indonesia **Nice to have** * Mapping or 3D libraries (MapLibre, Leaflet, Three.js) * DOCX/PDF generation and LibreOffice or Gotenberg * Domain knowledge in aviation safety, UAS operations, or another regulated compliance domain * Experience in the Unmanned Systems or Aerospace * Experience owning features end to end on a small team Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Developer - Backend
jobs.descriptionHtml: **[PT Mitra Cakra Digital — Tech Team]** **Kami mencari Developer Backend - Java / Spring untuk bergabung dalam tim engineering kami.** Di peran ini, Anda akan bertanggung jawab membangun layanan backend berbasis Java/Spring yang tangguh, teruji, dan sesuai standar arsitektur enterprise. Tidak hanya mengembangkan API biasa, Anda juga akan merancang komponen berbasis event (Event-Driven Architecture), membuat pustaka (SDK) internal untuk tim developer lain, serta menjaga alur pertukaran data agar tetap high-throughput, andal, dan fault-tolerant. Jika Anda peduli pada kualitas kode, menguasai ekosistem Java, serta memiliki ketertarikan pada Apache Kafka dan Developer Experience (DevEx), posisi ini sangat tepat untuk Anda. Apa yang akan Anda lakukan: Mengembangkan layanan backend dan komponen berbasis event menggunakan Java, Spring Boot, serta message broker (Apache Kafka). Membangun, mendokumentasikan, dan memelihara pustaka (library) atau SDK internal untuk digunakan oleh squad developer lain. Mengembangkan jalur integrasi yang andal antara sistem legacy dengan layanan baru sesuai rancangan sistem dan kontrak API. Menerapkan mekanisme penanganan kegagalan (fault tolerance) tingkat lanjut (retry, exponential backoff, Dead Letter Queue). Menulis pengujian otomatis (unit & integration testing) yang komprehensif sesuai standar test coverage tim. Melakukan code review secara aktif, menindaklanjuti temuan tim QA, serta melakukan perbaikan bug secara responsif. Memantau (monitoring) serta menjaga keandalan (reliability) dan performa alur pertukaran data antar layanan secara berkelanjutan. Kualifikasi Utama: Pengalaman minimal 4 tahun dalam pengembangan backend. Menguasai Java 17 (atau lebih baru) dan framework **Spring Boot 3 / 4** (termasuk Spring Kafka, REST API, dan JPA/Hibernate). Menguasai basis data relasional, khususnya **PostgreSQL**. Pengalaman hands-on dengan **Apache Kafka** beserta konsep intinya: producer, consumer group, partition, offset management, dan rebalancing. Menguasai serialisasi data menggunakan **Avro** serta pengelolaan **Schema Registry**. Memahami dan berpengalaman menerapkan pola arsitektur **event-driven** (idempotency, exactly-once processing, dan Outbox Pattern). Terbiasa dengan praktik automated testing (JUnit, Mockito). Memiliki pemahaman baik dan pengalaman hands-on dengan Git, Docker, serta pemahaman dasar Kubernetes. Soft Skill: Disiplin tinggi terhadap standar kode (no cowboy coding), teliti, komunikatif lintas peran (Frontend, QA, PM), serta memiliki sudut pandang "developer-as-a-customer" dalam menyusun dokumentasi teknis dan sample code. Nilai Tambah: Pengalaman membangun internal tools / SDK / open-source library. Familiar dengan Debezium / CDC atau pengelolaan Kafka di platform Cloud (AWS MSK, Confluent Cloud, dll). Memiliki pengalaman bekerja dengan metodologi Agile/Scrum dan tools CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins). Pengalaman di industri IT Consulting. Informasi Tambahan: Skema Bekerja: On-Site (Work From Office) – Kota Wisata, Gunung Putri, Kabupaten Bogor. Budaya Perusahaan: PT Mitra Cakra Digital menerapkan budaya kerja GROWTH (Grit, Results-Oriented, Ownership, World-Class, Techie, Harmony). Kami mendorong tim untuk bereksperimen, mencari solusi berbasis teknologi, dan tumbuh bersama. PT Mitra Cakra Digital berkomitmen pada kesetaraan kesempatan kerja. Work Location: In person

jobs.descriptionHtml: Job Description * Mengembangkan, membangun, dan memelihara aplikasi web dari sisi frontend dan backend sesuai dengan kebutuhan bisnis perusahaan. * Merancang, mengembangkan, dan mengoptimalkan antarmuka pengguna (UI) yang responsif, interaktif, dan mudah digunakan. * Mengembangkan dan memelihara server-side logic, API, serta integrasi dengan database dan layanan pihak ketiga. * Merancang, mengelola, dan mengoptimalkan database untuk memastikan keamanan, konsistensi, dan efisiensi pengolahan data. * Mengintegrasikan frontend dengan backend untuk memastikan seluruh fitur aplikasi berjalan dengan baik. * Mengembangkan dan memelihara RESTful API atau layanan API lainnya sesuai kebutuhan sistem. * Melakukan pengujian, debugging, dan troubleshooting untuk mengidentifikasi serta memperbaiki bug atau permasalahan teknis. * Mengoptimalkan performa, skalabilitas, keamanan, dan stabilitas aplikasi. * Melakukan deployment, pemeliharaan, serta pemantauan aplikasi pada lingkungan development, staging, dan production. * Mengembangkan dan memelihara integrasi dengan sistem eksternal, termasuk payment gateway, layanan cloud, dan aplikasi pihak ketiga jika diperlukan. * Berkolaborasi dengan tim UI/UX Designer, Product Manager, QA, dan tim terkait untuk memastikan pengembangan produk sesuai dengan kebutuhan dan spesifikasi. * Melakukan code review, menulis kode yang terstruktur, serta menerapkan standar dan best practices dalam pengembangan perangkat lunak. * Menyusun dan memelihara dokumentasi teknis, termasuk dokumentasi API, arsitektur sistem, dan alur pengembangan aplikasi. * Mengidentifikasi peluang perbaikan dan memberikan rekomendasi teknis untuk meningkatkan kualitas serta efisiensi sistem. * Mengikuti perkembangan teknologi dan menerapkan solusi yang relevan untuk mendukung pengembangan produk perusahaan. **Qualifications:** * Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Teknik Informatika, Ilmu Komputer, Sistem Informasi, atau bidang terkait. * Memiliki pengalaman kerja sebagai Full Stack Developer atau posisi serupa. * Menguasai HTML, CSS, dan JavaScript atau TypeScript untuk pengembangan frontend. * Memiliki pengalaman menggunakan framework frontend seperti React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, atau framework sejenis. * Menguasai bahasa pemrograman backend seperti JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, PHP, Java, atau bahasa lain yang relevan. * Memiliki jobs.title: Software Engineer (Backend) - E-Money [Go/Java]
jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer-2 Job Title Software Engineer (Backend) - E-Money [Go/Java] Job Description We are looking for Software Engineer (Backend). As a software engineer, you'll be the brain behind crafting, developing, testing, going live, and maintaining the system. You are passionate in understanding the business context for features built to drive better customer experience and adoption. **About E-Money** As part of Flip's Consumer Solutions group, you will be the go-to person to work on our e-money part, mainly the Flip Saldo feature. You will be working with a cross-functional team to answer various business questions e.g. increasing the number of transacting users with Flip Saldo. You will be utilizing different tech stacks for various use cases, such as Java (for E-Money core system), Go (cash top-up feature in one of the top Indonesian retailers), and PHP to a certain use case (integration with monolithic system). **About Flip** Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar, who were college friends in Universitas Indonesia, started Flip as a project in 2015 to transfer payments to each other at a fraction of what banks would charge them. They are pioneers in the Indonesian market, with their technology now helping millions of Indonesians, both individuals and businesses, carry out bank-to-bank money transfers through a reliable and seamless app. After nine years of operations, Flip has helped Indonesians transfer money worth several trillions of rupiah and has received double-digit funding from respectable investors such as Sequoia India, Insight Partner, and Insignia. Flip’s ultimate mission is to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world. At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. **What you'll do** * Work cross-functionally with the Product, Design, Operations, and Backend teams across the squads to ship world-class products and features. * Write code that's clear, concise, performant, tested, and easily understood by others. * Partner with the product management team to execute the feature roadmap. * Work with the overall backend teams to execute the engineering roadmap. * Help debug production issues across services and levels of the stack. **What you'll need** * Have a solid background in common programming problems and solutions. * Experience working with payment and/or accounting system is preferrable. * Knowledge and experience in Java and Go, PHP Yii2 experience is a plus. * Experience in working with large data set and/or high concurrency system is a plus. * Solid understanding of algorithms, algorithmic complexities, OOP, design patterns, and clean code. * Ability to plan, prioritize, estimate, and execute a task with a good degree of predictability. * Ability to scope, review and refine user stories and/or tasks for technical completeness and to alleviate dependency risk.

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer (Backend) - Core
jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer-1 Job Title Junior Software Engineer (Backend) - Core Job Description We’re hiring **Junior Software Engineers (Backend)** to join the **Core Payment Platform team** at Flip. If you’re passionate about building reliable systems, eager to learn, and excited to work on products that impact millions of Indonesians, this is your chance. **About Core Payment Platform** As part of the Payment Platform group, our team builds and maintains the critical services that power Flip’s ecosystem. We run over 20 projects that are essential for all business verticals, from money transfers to financial products. Our current mission is to break down Flip’s monolith service and set new engineering standards across the company. This is a rare opportunity to work on systems at scale, while learning modern backend practices in a supportive environment. We primarily use **Go** for our backend services, with **PostgreSQL** and **Redis** as our main data stores. Depending on the project, we use a mix of in-house tools and **Google Cloud Platform** services. **About Flip** Flip was founded in 2015 by three friends from Universitas Indonesia — Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar — with the goal of making money transfers fairer for Indonesians. Today, millions of individuals and businesses trust Flip to send trillions of rupiah across banks every year. We’re backed by leading investors such as **Sequoia India, Insight Partners, and Insignia**, and our mission is simple: **to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world.** At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. **What you’ll do** * Work with senior engineers to build and maintain backend services used across Flip’s ecosystem. * Write clear, tested, and efficient code, mainly in Go. * Review and learn from code written by peers and provide constructive feedback. * Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver reliable features. * Help troubleshoot and resolve production issues under guidance. **What you’ll need** * Basic programming experience in any backend language (Go experience is a strong plus). * Understanding of core computer science concepts: data structures, algorithms, OOP, and clean code principles. * Willingness to learn new tools and technologies quickly. * Good problem-solving mindset and eagerness to grow. * Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate in a team. * Alignment with Flip’s values of fairness, respect, and continuous learning. **Why join Flip?** * Learn directly from experienced engineers working on large-scale systems. * Be part of a mission-driven company making finance fairer in Indonesia. * Grow your career in a supportive and collaborative environment. * Enjoy fair rewards, clear goals, and recognition for your contributions.

jobs.title: Lead (Backend) Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About the GEO Team** ---------------------- GEO stands for Generative Engine Optimization. The GEO team builds products that help multi-location brands understand and improve how they are represented, cited, and recommended across AI-powered search and answer engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. We are building backend capabilities that collect and analyse signals from rapidly evolving AI platforms, measure brand visibility, and turn complex data into actionable recommendations for our customers. **About the Role** ------------------ As Backend Engineering Lead for Uberall’s GEO team, you will take on a **hybrid role that combines people management with hands-on engineering**. You will be responsible for the growth and effectiveness of the team, and you will also write code, review pull requests, and shape technical designs alongside them. On this team, leads stay close to the work. Hands-on contribution is a core part of the role, not something you step back from as the team grows. You will shape the architecture behind our AI-search products, lead the delivery of new capabilities, and help the team navigate a fast-moving and technically ambiguous domain. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders, you will translate customer needs and emerging developments in generative AI into reliable, scalable, and maintainable backend solutions. **Your Responsibilities** ------------------------- ### **People leadership** * Lead and develop the GEO backend team. This covers hiring, regular 1:1s, performance conversations, and supporting each engineer’s growth. * Own delivery with Product. Shape priorities, make sure commitments are realistic, and remove blockers so the team ships steadily. * Build the engineering culture of the team: shared standards, constructive code reviews, knowledge sharing, and collective ownership of quality. ### **Hands-on engineering** * Contribute regularly to design, code, and reviews as an active member of the team, not only as a reviewer or approver. * Guide the design and operation of backend systems that integrate with LLMs and AI-powered search platforms. * Establish robust approaches for evaluating the quality and consistency of AI-generated results. * Ensure that LLM-enabled capabilities are observable, testable, cost-efficient, and resilient to changing models and external providers. * Help the team manage the particular challenges of generative AI systems, including non-deterministic behaviour, latency, rate limits, data quality, and graceful degradation. * Stay informed about relevant developments in LLMs and AI search, assessing them pragmatically rather than adopting technology for its own sake. **Your Profile** ---------------- ### **Must have** * Proven experience leading an engineering team with genuine people responsibility (hiring, 1:1s, performance, and delivery) while continuing to contribute code and technical design. * Motivation to stay hands-on as a lead, balancing management responsibilities with regular engineering work. * Strong proficiency in Kotlin or Groovy; proven coding skills in other JVM languages (such as Java or Scala) are a plus. * Solid experience with our core stack and architecture: Spring Boot, Hibernate, JUnit, MySQL, Elasticsearch, Docker, AWS and OpenAPI, applied within microservice and event-driven systems. * Hands-on experience building or operating production systems that use LLMs, generative AI, or AI-powered external services. * An understanding of how to evaluate and monitor LLM-enabled features beyond traditional deterministic testing. * Experience designing reliable integrations with third-party APIs and managing concerns such as cost, latency, rate limits, observability, and provider failure. * The ability to distinguish between an effective AI use case and one better solved with conventional software. ### **Nice to have** * Experience with Python and LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph. * Experience with prompt management, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, or LLM evaluation frameworks. No experience training foundation models is required; this is a backend engineering and engineering leadership role.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: #### **Build the backbone of BYD's supply chain digital ecosystem — architect high-performance backend systems powering operations across Indonesia and beyond.** #### **Location: Subang, Indonesia** ### **Job Responsibilities** * Oversee the back-end technical system planning, architecture design and continuous iteration of the supply chain business line, to guarantee the forward-looking design, stability and scalability of the systems. * Take the lead in major business projects and core system reconstruction, and resolve technical challenges including high concurrency, high availability and data consistency. * Formulate and drive the implementation of development specifications, quality standards and performance baselines for the team. * Act as the technical lead, take charge of core talent cultivation and echelon building, and conduct critical technical decision-making and technical reviews. * Gain an in-depth understanding of business, participate in product and business planning, and translate complex business requirements into efficient and implementable technical solutions. * Keep track of industry technical trends and formulate the evolution roadmap of the team's technology stack. ### **Requirements** * Bachelor's degree or above; majors related to Computer Science such as Software Engineering, Network Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Digital Media Technology and Electronic Information are preferred. * Solid English skills in reading, writing and communication; proficiency in an additional foreign language is a plus. * No less than 5 years of back-end development experience with proven experience in developing large-scale distributed systems. * Solid foundational knowledge of Java, proficient in IO, multithreading, collections and mainstream basic frameworks, in-depth research on underlying principles, and familiar with the internal operating mechanism of JVM. * Skilled in mainstream development frameworks including Spring Boot and Spring Cloud. * Experienced with message queues (Kafka), distributed cache, ElasticSearch and other middleware technologies. * Familiar with relational databases (Oracle) and NoSQL databases, capable of designing heterogeneous data systems. ### **Recruitment Fraud Notice** PT BYD Auto Indonesia **does not charge any fees** at any stage of the recruitment process. This includes, but is not limited to, application fees, testing fees, interview fees, medical examination (MCU) fees, processing fees, travel expenses, or any other recruitment-related costs. Please remain vigilant against fraudulent recruitment activities carried out in the name of PT BYD Auto Indonesia. All official recruitment communications will only be conducted through our authorized corporate channels.

jobs.descriptionHtml: Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology startup helping freight forwarders turn data into better decisions and measurable business impact. Portcast uses AI to surface shipment exceptions, cost risks, and the right actions, helping teams focus on the shipments that need their attention, keep freight costs under control, and make procurement decisions with confidence. Our vision is to be the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment. Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are building for an industry at a critical inflection point of digital transformation. Our team of software engineers, data scientists, and logistics experts is on a mission to build the technology that helps freight forwarders protect margin, improve operational efficiency, and differentiate their offering. ### **ABOUT THE ROLE:** As our Backend Engineer, you will be reporting directly to our Engineering Manager and will work closely with our Product team to develop new products, scale existing ones and manage deployments and architecture. You won't just take tickets here. You'll dig into how the system actually works, ask why before how, and chase a problem past the surface to the real cause. Curiosity isn't a nice-to-have on this team, it's how we build. ### **WHAT YOU’LL OWN:** * Design, build and maintain APIs, services and systems and debug production issues across multiple levels of the stack. * Collaborate closely with our Business, Product and Data Science teams to understand and solve customer pain points at scale. * Design, Develop, Implement and Deploy enterprise level, high availability web application platforms, with support from the design team at Portcast. * Create a technology infrastructure that functions well at scale. You will design and improve the system architecture. * Own end-to-end the design AND implementation of how our product handles real-time data at scale, from event ingestion across dozens of carrier sources, through data normalization, through ML-powered risk and ETA models, to the user-visible recommendations our enterprise customers act on. * Build features customers actually use, harden internal tooling the team relies on, and create the alerting and monitoring surfaces that catch issues before customers do. You're a builder first, with the judgment to know what's worth building. * Make architecture trade-offs explicit and defensible. * Instrument what you build, find real bottlenecks, and pick fixes that survive the next 10× of growth, not just the next sprint. You measure before you optimize, and your numbers are reproducible. ### **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:** * Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or equivalent work experience in the field. * Work Experience: Minimum 5+ years of experience in a technical role designing, developing and releasing technical solutions and building production systems. * Curious by Default: You dig deeper instead of following instructions to the letter. When something in the system surprises you, you chase the why, not just the fix. You treat every layer of the stack as something worth understanding, and you ask the good questions early. * System Architecture: You understand how parts of a system fit together and have a strong background in building scalable products or systems. You are comfortable in dealing with lots of moving pieces/data sources and possess meticulous attention to detail. You are quick to generate ideas and give suggestions on how to improve the tech stack and feature developments. * First Principles Thinker: When you explain a past decision, the trade-offs come out before the tools. You name the constraint, the alternatives you considered, and why you picked what you picked. You don't reach for a new framework when a tighter use of an existing tool would do the job. * You use AI tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude, etc.) where they make you faster, and you know exactly where they fall short. You read what they produce, you don't just paste it. You can defend a code path the AI suggested, or override it with reasoning the AI couldn't have known. You flag AI-assisted decisions in code review and submissions without being asked. We treat AI as a tool that makes good thinking faster, not a shortcut around thinking. * Team Player: You have experience working in a diverse, dynamic and cross-cultural team. This role is an opportunity to drive engineering excellence within the team and participate in key architectural discussions. You are a hands-on goal-orientated engineer who works according to milestones and software guidelines, following agile principles. * Empathetic Communicator: You can communicate nuanced ideas clearly, from real-time remote brainstorming to explaining a technical decision in writing. You may be opinionated, but in disagreements you engage thoughtfully with other perspectives and can compromise when needed. * You've either been an early engineering hire at a startup where you took a technical product from scratch to scale, OR you've owned real system design at a FAANG-tier engineering org, defended architectural decisions in actual design reviews, not just contributed to someone else's blueprint. Either path counts! We'd love to hear the learnings and the trade-offs you'd make differently today. * Tech Stack: Ideally you are proficient with Python-based backend programming, web frameworks like Flask, Amazon Web Services. You are able to design RESTful APIs and are aware of best practices. Experience with Docker, Git, Elasticsearch, Spark, CI/CD is a plus. The specific stack matters less than how you reason about it. Strong engineers in any stack pick ours up quickly. ### **WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:** * Globally distributed, remote-first flexibility: Work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration. Our diversity of perspectives fuels innovation and keeps us curious. * Tech-first team: You’ll work with like-minded individuals who share a passion for solving difficult problems using technology. * Accelerated growth: Compress the learning curve in a couple of years by owning the web app from day one as your own baby. We are building our company to be the next B2B market leader in predictive global supply chains and you’ll be a major part of our story. * Impact you can see: With a lean structure, your work is effective from the start. You’ll see the results of your ideas and decisions directly moving the business forward. ### **Our CORE Values Guide Everything We Do:** * Curiosity: We read the code before we trust it. We dig into why a system behaves the way it does, not just how to make the error go away. * Ownership: We act like founders. We don't wait for a ticket to fix what's broken, and we stay on a problem until it's actually solved in production. * Raising the bar: We do not settle for code that only works locally or solves the immediate request. We aim for backend systems that are reliable, scalable, maintainable, and easy for the team to reason about. * Effectiveness: We focus on engineering work that creates real product and customer impact. We prioritize the right problems, make practical trade-offs, and ship solutions that improve outcomes, not just output. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: IT Business Analyst – Banking Industry
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Kualifikasi:** * Minimal **S1** dari jurusan **Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Manajemen, Ekonomi, atau bidang terkait**. * Memiliki **pengalaman kerja minimal 5 tahun** sebagai **Business Analyst** di industri **perbankan** (retail, corporate, digital banking, atau core banking system). * Memiliki pemahaman yang baik tentang **proses bisnis perbankan** seperti: * Core Banking System (Deposit, Loan, Payment, GL, CIF) * Digital Banking (Mobile Banking, Internet Banking) * Regulatory Reporting (BI-FAST, LLDIKTI, OJK, dsb.) * Mampu melakukan **analisis kebutuhan bisnis dan sistem (BRD, FSD, SRS)**. * Berpengalaman dalam **koordinasi dengan user, vendor, dan tim teknis (developer, tester, infra)**. * Mampu melakukan **gathering requirement, mapping proses bisnis, dan gap analysis**. * Memiliki kemampuan dalam **dokumentasi proses bisnis, workflow, dan use case diagram** (menggunakan tools seperti Visio, Draw.io, Lucidchart, atau BPMN). * Terbiasa dengan **metodologi SDLC / Agile Scrum**. * Memiliki kemampuan **komunikasi, koordinasi, dan presentasi** yang baik. * Detail-oriented, analitis, dan mampu bekerja mandiri maupun dalam tim. **Scope of Work:** * Melakukan **analisis kebutuhan bisnis** dari stakeholder dan memastikan kesesuaiannya dengan tujuan proyek. * Membuat **Business Requirement Document (BRD)** dan berkolaborasi dengan tim teknis untuk menyusun **Functional Specification Document (FSD)**. * Melakukan **analisis gap** antara kebutuhan bisnis dengan sistem yang ada. * Mendukung proses **UAT (User Acceptance Test)** termasuk penyusunan test scenario dan verifikasi hasil. * Melakukan **koordinasi dengan user bisnis, tim IT, dan vendor eksternal** terkait pengembangan dan implementasi sistem. * Memberikan **rekomendasi solusi bisnis dan sistem** yang efektif untuk mendukung efisiensi operasional perbankan. * Membuat **laporan perkembangan proyek** secara berkala kepada manajemen. * Mendukung proses **improvement sistem dan kebijakan operasional** sesuai kebutuhan regulator (OJK, BI, dll). **Nilai Tambah (Nice to Have):** * Memiliki pengalaman dengan **project BI-FAST, SNAP, ISO 20022, Core Banking Migration**, atau sistem **Digital Channel Banking**. * Familiar dengan **SQL query, data mapping, atau basic data analytics**. * Memiliki **sertifikasi CBAP, ECBA, atau Agile Business Analyst** menjadi nilai tambah. Jika Anda cocok dengan posisi dan industri yang disebutkan di atas atau memiliki referensi untuk kandidat yang sesuai, silakan hubungi kami WA: 087777686171 Jenis Pekerjaan: Kontrak Pertanyaan Lamaran: * berapa Usia Anda? * Apakahkamu Familiar dengan SQL query, data mapping, atau basic data analytics.? * Apakah kamu Memiliki pengalaman dengan project BI-FAST, SNAP, ISO 20022, Core Banking Migration, atau sistem Digital Channel Banking.? Pendidikan: * S1 (Diwajibkan) Pengalaman: * IT Bisnis Analys: 5 tahun (Diwajibkan) Bahasa: * English (Diutamakan) Lokasi Kerja: Tatap muka

jobs.title: BUSINESS ANALYST SPECIALIST
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Spesifikasi Fisik** --------------------- Tinggi Min. 170 cm Berat Min. 50 kg **Deskripsi Pekerjaan** ----------------------- * Menyusun laporan analisis bisnis secara periodik dan ad-hoc dengan visualisasi data yang jelas, narasi analitis yang kuat, serta rekomendasi strategis yang dapat langsung digunakan sebagai dasar pengambilan keputusan manajemen. * Melakukan analisis performa outlet dan unit bisnis dengan membandingkan target versus realisasi, tren historis, serta variabel operasional untuk mengidentifikasi peluang peningkatan revenue dan efisiensi biaya. * Mendukung perencanaan bisnis dan forecasting melalui analisis proyeksi pendapatan, biaya, dan skenario bisnis berdasarkan data aktual serta asumsi yang terukur dan dapat dipertanggungjawabkan. * Berkolaborasi dengan tim Finance, Operation, Marketing, dan HR untuk menerjemahkan kebutuhan bisnis menjadi model analisis, KPI, dan dashboard yang selaras dengan tujuan strategis HW Group. * Mengembangkan dan memelihara dashboard serta tools analitik yang memungkinkan monitoring performa bisnis secara real-time atau periodik dengan struktur data yang konsisten dan mudah dipahami oleh user non-teknis. * Melakukan evaluasi terhadap proses bisnis dan alur kerja dengan pendekatan data-driven untuk mengidentifikasi inefisiensi, risiko operasional, serta peluang perbaikan proses yang berdampak langsung pada kinerja bisnis. * Menyediakan analisis pendukung untuk inisiatif strategis perusahaan seperti pembukaan outlet baru, pengembangan konsep, pricing strategy, dan investasi dengan menyajikan data, insight, serta rekomendasi berbasis fakta. **Persyaratan** --------------- * S1 Sistem Informasi, Teknik Industri, Statistika, Manajemen, atau bidang relevan * Pengalaman minimal 2–3 tahun sebagai Business Analyst di bidang relevan * Soft Competency: Analytical Thinking, Critical Thinking, Problem Solving, Communication Skill, Attention to Detail * Technical Competency: Data Analysis, Microsoft Excel, Data Visualization, Financial Analysis, Business Intelligence **Ringkasan lowongan** ---------------------- Kategori FULLTIME Departemen BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE DEPARTMENT jobs.title: SPORT ANALYST INTERNATIONAL
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Analis Sepak Bola lnternasional** Bertanggung jawab menyajikan analisis pertandingan dan kompetisi berbasis data serta sumber tepercaya sebagai bahan editorial untuk preview, prediksi, dan liputan sepak bola. Deskripsi Pekerjaan * Menganalisis performa terkini tim dan pemain dengan mempertimbangkan hasil, konsistensi, produktivitas, serta konteks pertandingan. * Mengkaji pendekatan taktik, kekuatan dan kelemahan, kemungkinan susunan pemain, absensi, kondisi kandang/tandang, serta faktor teknis lain yang relevan. * Menganalisis rekor pertemuan, jadwal, kondisi kompetisi, dan data pendukung lain tanpa mengabaikan keterbatasan atau konteks datanya. * Menyusun preview dan prediksi pertandingan, termasuk alasan yang mendasari prediksi; membedakan fakta, interpretasi, dan opini dengan jelas. * Membuat brief analisis yang ringkas, akurat, mudah dipahami, dan dapat digunakan Editor sebagai bahan pengembangan artikel. * Memantau berita dan perkembangan yang berdampak pada analisis, serta memperbarui brief bila terdapat perubahan penting. * Mencantumkan sumber untuk data dan klaim, memeriksa keandalan sumber, dan tidak menyajikan spekulasi sebagai fakta. * Berkolaborasi dengan Editor untuk memastikan sudut analisis sesuai kebutuhan pembaca dan rencana editorial. **Kualifikasi** * Memiliki pengetahuan mendalam tentang sepak bola Indonesia, Vietnam, dan internasional serta kompetisi, klub, pemain, dan taktik. * Mampu menganalisis performa, taktik, rekor pertemuan, dan faktor teknis; mampu menjelaskan kesimpulan secara logis dan terstruktur. * Terampil melakukan riset dari beberapa sumber tepercaya dan memeriksa konsistensi data sebelum digunakan. * Mampu menulis dalam bahasa Indonesia dengan jelas; mampu membaca sumber berbahasa Inggris menjadi nilai tambah. * Teliti, kritis, memenuhi tenggat, dan terbuka terhadap evaluasi hasil prediksi maupun kualitas analisis. * Nilai tambah: pengalaman membuat preview/prediksi, menggunakan data statistik sepak bola, atau bekerja dengan media olahraga. * Perlu dicatat, khususnya, bahwa para editor tidak diperbolehkan menggunakan kecerdasan buatan (AI) untuk menulis artikel. Work Location: Hybrid remote in Jakarta Raya

jobs.title: UI/UX Designer (26-07001)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Jadi bagian dari tim hebat dari perusahaan global.** ------------------------------------------------------ Bergabunglah dengan perusahaan global kami dan buka peluang tanpa batas dengan berkolaborasi bersama tim yang beragam dan berbakat. Bersama-sama, kami menciptakan kesuksesan, mendorong inovasi, dan menciptakan dunia dengan berbagai peluang yang tak terbatas. ### **Detail Pekerjaan** * Conduct research about website and app UI and UX based on target audience, needs, and behaviors. * Create wireframes (basic sketches) to outline the structure and layout of the website or app. * Develop interactive UI/UX prototypes to demonstrate how the product will function. * Design the look and feel of the product, including color schemes, typography, and iconography. * Ensure the design aligns with the brand identity and is visually appealing. * Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to bring designs to life. * Create and maintain design systems or style guides to ensure consistency across the product. * Document design standards and best practices. ### **Persyaratan Keahlian** * Have minimum 3 years' experience as UI/UX Designer. * Must have experience with design tools like Adobe XD, Figma etc. * Must have experience in mobile and web design. * Understand design practical and user centered digital experience using modern design tools methodologies. * Can collaborate with team to improve UI/UX based expected output result. * Strong understanding of design principles, including layout, color theory, and typography. * Strong eye for detail in creating pixel-perfect designs. ### **Tingkat Pendidikan** * Bachelor Degree of Graphic Design, Interaction Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field. * Diploma 3 Diploma from any discipline.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Overview** In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as a **Critical Environment Electrical Engineer.** Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I Electrical Engineer, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications. Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide. With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. **Responsibilities** **Responsibilities**: ***Design*** * Develop basic knowledge of industry trends, competitors' products, customer experience, and advances in various engineering fields. Consult with other engineers to help understand and apply advanced concepts. * Assist in the creation and execution of robust, scalable, secure, and extensible designs and/or verification plans for the electrical engineering aspects of a well-defined feature or product extension (e.g., a product refresh, or line extension). * Participate in creating intellectual property. May file patents within personal area of scope and complete necessary patent documentation. * Implement known solutions to common technical and/or design challenges, with some guidance from other engineers. * Read device specification sheets and interpret common details required to design and test various hardware features. * Develop design documentation which could include drawings, specifications, schematics, or diagrams for features of well-defined products with guidance and direction from a manager or other engineers. * Review supplier or partner technical sheets for available parts and choose appropriate parts needed to support product development. ***Testing and Verification*** * Ensure that test requirements are included in documentation and specifications for a feature or product. * Determine the appropriate test equipment (e.g., oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, logic analyzers) for measuring a feature of a product according to existing verification plans, with minimal supervision from other engineers. * Write design verification test cases using standard templates and test methodologies. * Develop, review, and execute test plans and/or infrastructure for standard features or products. * Assist in developing automated testing solutions and independently conduct automated testing on standard feature areas or products. * Gather data for external testing supplier or partner selection options. * Assist in setting up and breaking down testing environments with guidance and supervision from other engineers. Follow safety guidelines. * Participate in the development of dashboards or reports for testing and quality metrics that can be utilized to characterize hardware and hardware performance. * Analyze and interpret results of data and statistical analyses to identify common problems or flaws that may affect a feature or product design change and bring them to the attention of other engineers or team leads. * Assist in the development of basic test fixtures for use in testing or validation of new product features under guidance from other engineers. ***Technical Project Implementation*** * Follow project implementation schedules to deliver the hardware engineering aspects of a well-defined feature or product. Escalate issues to management as necessary. * Implement and track product plans, under guidance from other engineers. * Highlight potential issues that may affect downstream execution of projects (e.g., performance vs. reliability and manufacturing concerns). * Research new tools, technologies, or processes for project implementation and provide reports to project team members. * Assist in implementing risk assessments (e.g., supplier or partner delays, incomplete specs, or tool issues) into project plans. * Communicate project progress/status within the project team and escalate issues as necessary. ***Reporting and Documentation*** * Follow established procedures to participate in creating detailed reports and functional specifications for a well-defined product feature or extension, based on audits and information from product development and verification processes. * Document essential details about materials, components, and/or assemblies for a device via accepted release processes. Accurately record and track changes to designs following established processes with some guidance from other engineers. ***Other*** * Embody the Microsoft One culture and values. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications:** * 4+ years of technical engineering experience + OR Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field **Background Check Requirements:** Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: * Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. While not required, we also look for the following **Preferred Qualifications****:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field AND 1+ year(s) of technical engineering experience + OR Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field. This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About WegoPro** ----------------- WegoPro is the business travel platform built for modern companies. We help organisations simplify and control corporate travel by bringing together booking, approvals, policy, payments, and reporting into one intelligent platform. As part of the Wego Group, we're combining deep travel expertise with AI-first product development to redefine how businesses travel. **The Role** ------------ We're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to help build the frontend platform that powers WegoPro. You'll work on a sophisticated, data-rich product used every day by travel managers, finance teams, and business travellers around the world. This is a hands-on senior engineering role with significant technical ownership. You'll shape our frontend architecture, establish engineering standards, mentor other developers, and build AI-powered experiences that make complex workflows feel intuitive. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own the architecture and evolution of our frontend platform, including our design system, application state, routing, build tooling, and performance. * Build scalable frontend systems on top of a microservices architecture, designing resilient API integrations, caching strategies, and graceful fallbacks when services fail. * Develop AI-powered product experiences, including conversational booking, agentic workflows, and streaming interfaces that make AI interactions feel reliable and trustworthy. * Drive adoption of AI-assisted software development, helping define best practices for using tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex across the engineering team. * Lead technical design discussions, perform thoughtful code reviews, and mentor engineers to raise the quality of the team's work. * Take ownership of software quality from development through production, including automated testing, observability, CI/CD, and operational excellence on AWS. * Partner closely with Product, Design, and Backend Engineering to deliver intuitive, performant user experiences. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Significant experience building modern web applications, with deep expertise developing complex, stateful single-page applications. * Expert knowledge of Vue 3, including the Composition API, Pinia, Nuxt, and a strong understanding of Vue's reactivity model. * Strong TypeScript skills and experience with modern frontend tooling, including Vite, code splitting, performance optimisation, and Core Web Vitals. * Excellent frontend engineering fundamentals, with a passion for building polished, accessible, responsive user interfaces. * Daily experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex, with sound judgement about where they accelerate development and where they don't. * Familiarity with modern AI application development, including MCP, agent frameworks, context engineering, evaluation frameworks, and shipping user-facing AI features. * Practical experience with AWS services including S3, CloudFront, Lambda, ECS, CI/CD pipelines, and feature flagging. * Strong communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and a bias for ownership, delivery, and continuous improvement. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience building products in business travel, fintech, or B2B SaaS. * Experience with micro-frontend architectures. * Experience building or maintaining design systems. * Contributions to open-source projects in the Vue or AI tooling ecosystem. **Why Join WegoPro?** --------------------- At WegoPro, you'll solve meaningful engineering challenges spanning global travel inventory, multi-currency pricing, enterprise policy engines, and large-scale integrations. You'll join a highly collaborative team where engineers have real ownership, technical decisions have lasting impact, and modern AI tooling is embedded into the way we build software every day. If you're excited by complex frontend engineering, AI-native product development, and building software that powers business travel at scale, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: UI/UX Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Jenis:** Full Time **Lokasi:** On-Site (Semarang) Kami sedang mencari UI/UX Designer yang kreatif dan berbakat untuk bergabung dengan Techarea. Sebagai UI/UX Designer, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam mengubah ide-ide dan konsep menjadi antarmuka pengguna yang menarik dan fungsional. **Tugas dan Kewajiban:** ------------------------ * Menyiapkan *storyboards*, alur proses, atau *sitemap* untuk memberikan pandangan holistik tentang desain. * Merancang *wireframe* yang akan menjadi dasar untuk pengembangan antarmuka pengguna. * Merancang antarmuka pengguna yang konsisten, fungsional, mudah dikembangkan, dan memikat secara visual. * Membuat *mockup* dan prototipe yang mencerminkan fungsionalitas desain. * Melakukan iterasi desain hingga mencapai desain yang optimal. * Bekerja sama secara erat dengan tim developer untuk mengoordinasikan proses *handoff* desain. **Kualifikasi:** ---------------- * Memahami prinsip-prinsip desain dan praktik terbaik desain UI. * Memahami prinsip-prinsip UX dan dapat membuat desain UI untuk berbagai perangkat. * Memahami istilah-istilah dalam bahasa Inggris terkait desain UI/UX. * Memiliki pengetahuan mendalam dan kemampuan menggunakan aplikasi desain UI/UX. * Kemampuan bekerja secara mandiri dan berkolaborasi dalam tim. * Proaktif dan responsif dalam berkomunikasi dengan tim, serta mampu memberikan dan menerima umpan balik dengan konstruktif. * Pendidikan minimal SMK bidang Teknologi dan Rekayasa, Teknologi Informasi, atau bidang terkait, dengan pengalaman minimal 1 tahun sebagai UI/UX Designer.

jobs.title: UI/UX Designer - Product
jobs.descriptionHtml: Department Product Management LevelExperienced (Individual Contributor) LocationJakarta The Product Management team at Shopee is the key focal point between the business, engineering and design teams. The team is responsible for implementing strategy, road maps and features, while adhering to business goals. It covers all functions including but not limited to Financial Services, Supply Chain, Search, Recommendation, Advertising, Order, Promotion, User, Anti-Fraud, Seller Service. Join us to own a product that is impacting millions of lives in Southeast Asia and Taiwan. About the Team: Shopee is the leading e-commerce platform in Southeast Asia and Taiwan. We provide easy, secure, and fast online shopping experiences to our buyers and sellers every day. We’re looking for a mid-senior UI/UX designer to join us in enhancing our core e-commerce platforms. You will help improve the sellers’ experience in listing products, managing inventory, monitoring shop performance and marketing initiatives, and engaging with buyers through social and engagement features. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams of designers, writers, product managers, operations, and business analysts. Job Description: * Shape and design core e-commerce platforms across mobile and web dashboard interfaces within the project scope. * Develop high-fidelity mockups and interactive prototypes to effectively present product concepts to key stakeholders and leadership. * Collaborate closely with product and business counterparts to evaluate project requirements and translate them into intuitive user interfaces. * Drive user-centric solutions by advocating for user needs during team discussions and brainstorming sessions throughout the project lifecycle. Requirements: * Hold a minimum Bachelor's degree in Visual Communication Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. * Possess 1 to 4 years of hands-on experience in UI/UX design or product design for mobile and web dashboard interfaces. * Demonstrated portfolio showcasing end-to-end design thought processes, with experience in B2B user interfaces. * Proficient in written and spoken English to facilitate cross-border collaboration, with proficiency in Chinese as an added advantage. * High degree of ownership and agility to drive deliverables forward within dynamic project timelines. * Confident and assertive in design decision-making while remaining receptive to constructive feedback.
